story.fullStory:
Peter Gabriel's "Solsbury Hill" reached #68 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Solsbury Hill" is the debut solo single by the English rock musician Peter Gabriel and the first single from his 1977 self-titled album.

He wrote the song about a spiritual experience atop Solsbury Hill in Somerset, England, after his departure from the progressive rock band Genesis, of which he had been the lead vocalist since its inception.

The single was a Top 20 hit in the UK, peaking at number 13.

The song peaked at #68 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 8 weeks on the chart.
